newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VIERI OUT OF ITALY TEAM FOR WORLD CUP CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIERI OUT OF ITALY TEAM FOR WORLD CUP CLASH.

text.p: Juventus striker Christian Vieri is out of the Italian team to face Poland in a World Cup qualifying match in Naples on Wednesday. The 23-yearleft the team training camp near Florence on Sunday, suffering from tonsolitis. Vieri made a dream senior international debut last month scoring Italy's 1000th goal in international soccer in a 3-0 World Cup win against Moldova in Trieste. Four days later he won a second cap in a 0-0 draw with Chorzow and he had been expected to again lead the attack in Wednesday's return match.
Vieri won his place alongside Chelsea striker Gianfranco Zola, thanks to injuries to both Fabrizio Ravanelli of Middlesborough and Pierluigi Casiraghi of Lazio.

With Zola still uncertain because of a muscular problem, Italian coach Cesare Maldini may have to field an entirely new attack comprising either Ravanelli or Atalanta striker Filippo Inzaghi instead of Vieri and with AC Milan star Roberto Baggio replacing Zola.
Italy currently lead Group 2 with 13 points, four clear of second-placed England who have a game in hand.
